body.message:
Good Morning Abderahman,

Thank you for your message.

Yes, everything is included in the rate, including all bills and internet, and there are no additional fees.

The only applicable charges are the rent of AED 4,500 for 1 month ( 30 nights ) and the refundable security deposit of AED 2,000.

If everything is good from your side, we will be happy to proceed with the booking for next month.

Kindly let us know.
